## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactoring / maintenance
- [ ] Tests

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests pass
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes

- [ ] No secrets, personal data, media, databases, or backups included

## Notes / limitations

List compatibility considerations, screenshots (if useful), and known limitations.
